## Discovery & Translational Science

**[State of AI antibody design highlights target selection and immunogenicity hurdles](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/state-ai-antibody-design)** — *Science*
- Computational antibody design benefits from favorable baseline pharmacological properties, such as long plasma half-lives, but key translational bottlenecks persist.
- Unintended target biology (e.g., recent clinical anti-IL-6 failures in cardiovascular settings), off-target cross-reactivity, and anti-drug antibody immunogenicity remain critical failure modes for AI-generated candidates.

**[BAP1/ASXL3 complex regulates α-synuclein uptake via glycoproteome remodeling](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.09.26362627)** — *bioRxiv*
- A genome-wide CRISPR activation screen identified BRCA1-associated protein 1 (BAP1) as a key genetic modifier of α-synuclein fibril internalization.
- BAP1 acts as a master transcriptional regulator of the cell surface glycoproteome, downregulating heparan sulfate proteoglycans while upregulating O-linked glycoproteins to reduce fibril entry.
- Overexpression reduced α-synuclein uptake in iPSC-derived human dopaminergic neurons without impacting microglial phagocytosis.

**[Macrophage VEGFA signaling maintains aqueous humor outflow in aged eyes](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.20.746006)** — *bioRxiv*
- Single-cell sequencing and tissue imaging revealed age-dependent accumulation of peri-Schlemm’s canal (SC) macrophages alongside elevated VEGFA-VEGFR signaling in ocular angle tissues.
- Conditional deletion of *Vegfa* in CX3CR1⁺ macrophages led to elevated intraocular pressure and reduced aqueous humor outflow facility in 9-month-old mice.
- Findings indicate that macrophage-derived VEGFA acts as a homeostatic compensatory mechanism against age-related trabecular meshwork degradation.

**[Mitochondrial STARD7 inhibition blocks influenza virus replication](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42726897/)** — *PubMed*
- Small-molecule screen identified targeting of the mitochondrial lipid transfer protein STARD7 as a therapeutic strategy against seasonal influenza.
- Chemical inhibition of STARD7 disrupted viral replication dynamics, demonstrating the role of mitochondrial lipid transport machinery in supporting viral life cycles.

**[MGAT1 identified as a synthetic lethal target in STK11-mutant lung cancer](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42727848/)** — *PubMed*
- Combined genetic and biochemical screening identified mannosyl (α-1,3-)-glycoprotein β-1,2-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase (MGAT1) as a druggable vulnerability in *STK11*-mutated non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
- Inhibition of MGAT1 disrupted aberrant N-glycosylation pathways required for cell survival in *STK11*-deficient metabolic states.

**[Plasma p-tau217 tracks amyloid-independent neurodegeneration in Tuberous Sclerosis Complex](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.09.26362677)** — *medRxiv*
- Comparative biomarker evaluation across 63 patients with Tuberous Sclerosis Complex (TSC) revealed significant elevations in plasma phosphorylated tau-217 (p-tau217) relative to unimpaired controls.
- Hyperactivation of the mTOR pathway driven by *TSC1/2* loss of function promotes tau hyperphosphorylation independent of amyloid-β deposition, supporting p-tau217 as a pharmacodynamic biomarker for mTOR-targeted therapies.

**[In vivo CD19 cell therapy landscape map details target and platform strategies](https://x.com/andrewpannu/status/2098433799604371656)** — *X / @andrewpannu*
- An industry mapping of more than 90 in vivo CD19 cell therapy programs across 71 entities highlights that CD19 + BCMA remains the primary multi-target strategy, though single-target CD19 strategies continue to provide a distinct B-cell reset profile with potential safety advantages.
- Adding BCMA targets long-lived plasma cells capable of escaping CD19-only depletion, offering potential therapeutic utility across both oncology and autoimmune disease indications.
- Delivery platforms—including linear mRNA/tLNPs, circular RNA/tLNPs, and targeted lentiviral vectors—exert major influence over CAR expression duration and suitability for repeat dosing.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

**[Biotech]** **[First-in-class dual ATM/DNA-PK inhibitor XRD-0394 enters Phase 1a evaluation](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42727889/)** — *PubMed*
- Phase 1a dose-escalation trial evaluated XRD-0394, a potent dual inhibitor of ataxia telangiectasia mutated (ATM) and DNA-dependent protein kinase (DNA-PK), combined with palliative radiotherapy.
- The study established initial clinical safety, tolerability, and preliminary pharmacokinetics of dual DNA damage response (DDR) pathway inhibition during radiation therapy.

**[Biotech]** **[Anti-CD19 CAR-T miv-cel demonstrates CSF expansion and oligoclonal band clearance in progressive MS](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.11.26361992)** — *medRxiv*
- Pilot data from two patients with treatment-refractory progressive multiple sclerosis treated with autologous anti-CD19 CAR-T therapy (mivocabtagene autoleucel; miv-cel) showed robust cell expansion in the central nervous system at Day 14.
- Treatment led to sustained elimination of disease-associated cerebrospinal fluid oligoclonal bands and normalization of intrathecal IgG synthesis, with acceptable safety (one case of Grade 1 CRS; zero ICANS).

**[Big Pharma]** **[BioNTech and BMS present early data on pumitamig and B7-H3 combination](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2098703345204555912)** — *ApexOnco / X*
- Early data presented at WCLC 2026 highlights combining pumitamig (PM8002/BNT327, an anti-PD-L1/VEGF bispecific antibody) with a B7-H3-targeted agent.
- Preliminary efficacy signals suggest superior anti-tumor activity for the combination compared to single-agent administration in lung cancer models.

**[Closed-loop adaptive deep brain stimulation validated in Parkinson's pilot trial](https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.09.07.25335282)** — *medRxiv*
- A double-blind, randomized crossover trial (n = 9) compared dual-threshold subthalamic adaptive DBS (aDBS)—guided real-time by β-band local field potentials—against conventional DBS (cDBS) over consecutive one-month periods.
- Chronic aDBS proved feasible and delivered comparable clinical control of daily ON/OFF motor fluctuations while dynamically matching stimulation output to patient physiological state.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

**[Big Pharma]** **[AstraZeneca's oral SERD camizestrant misses primary endpoint in Phase 3 SERENA-4 trial](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/12/astrazeneca-breast-cancer-camizestrant-etcamah-serena-4-trail-failure/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT+*
- Camizestrant (Etcamah), a next-generation oral selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD), failed to reach its primary progression-free survival endpoint in the pivotal SERENA-4 study in ER-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer.
- The clinical failure follows recent accelerated regulatory approvals and threatens to restrict the drug's broad deployment in frontline settings.

**[Big Pharma]** **[Roche's Tecentriq fails Phase 3 IMpower-030 trial in perioperative NSCLC](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2098704103408828699)** — *ApexOnco / X*
- Phase 3 IMpower-030 evaluating periadjuvant atezolizumab (Tecentriq) plus chemotherapy in resectable non-small cell lung cancer failed to meet its primary event-free survival endpoint.
- Trial investigators at WCLC 2026 suggested trial design and statistical power assumptions contributed to the negative readout.

## Regulatory & Approvals

**[Biotech]** **[FDA approves Scholar Rock's Isembyld as first therapy for SMA muscle loss](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/11/scholar-rock-spinal-muscular-atrophy-isembyld-clinical-trial-fda-approval/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT+ / [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/fda-approves-first-therapy-target-muscle-loss-spinal-muscular-atrophy)*
- FDA approved Isembyld (apitegromab-mstn), a targeted inhibitor of latent myostatin activation, for patients aged 2 years and older with spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) receiving concurrent SMN2-targeted therapy.
- Pivotal data demonstrated significant improvements in motor function (HMFSE scale) after 12 months, addressing skeletal muscle atrophy alongside motor neuron survival.

**[Biotech]** **[FDA expands approval of Pharming's Joenja to pediatric APDS patients](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/fda-approves-first-treatment-children-aged-4-11-years-apds-rare-genetic-disorder-immune-system)** — *FDA*
- FDA granted label expansion for Joenja (leniolisib), a selective PI3Kδ inhibitor, extending its indication to pediatric patients aged 4 to 11 years (weighing ≥27 kg) with activated phosphoinositide 3-kinase delta syndrome (APDS).
- Weight-based oral dosing (40 mg, 50 mg, or 70 mg twice daily) was approved to target persistent lymphoproliferation and primary immunodeficiency in younger cohorts.

**[FDA announces public hearing on clinical framework for therapeutic psychedelics](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/fda-meetings-conferences-and-workshops/considerations-potential-future-therapeutic-use-psychedelic-drugs-public-hearing-09142026)** — *FDA*
- The agency scheduled a public hearing for September 14, 2026, to discuss regulatory pathways, clinical trial designs, and safety monitoring requirements for therapeutic psychedelic candidates.
- Sessions will address standardized delivery, psychotherapy integration, and risk mitigation strategies in supervised clinical environments.

## Business & Strategy

**[Biotech]** **[Karyopharm executes debt standstill agreement with lenders](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/imdelltra-bridgebio-oncology-evommune-encoded-tectora/830056/)** — *BioPharma Dive / [BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2098380960664338502)*
- Karyopharm Therapeutics finalized a forbearance agreement extending the due date on a $15.8 million debt payment through October 15, 2026.
- In exchange for the extension, Karyopharm issued $20 million in new convertible equity to creditors while actively seeking restructuring, licensing, or M&A options.

**[Venture activity accelerates led by mega-rounds from RA Capital and Eli Lilly](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/biotech-charts-ra-capital-venture-novartis-reverse-mergers/830052/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
- RA Capital Management expanded its clinical-stage investments, participating in Series A rounds for Solstice Oncology ($225 million) and Tectora Therapeutics ($55 million), following recent lead positions in Typewriter Therapeutics ($56 million) and Superluminal Medicines.
- Eli Lilly maintained an aggressive external innovation cadence, backing Superluminal, Cloverleaf Bio, Moonwalk Biosciences, and a novel oncology spinout from Kura Oncology.

**[Biotech]** **[Tempus AI launches project to sequence 100,000 whole human genomes](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2098398030529441907)** — *BioStocks / X*
- Tempus AI announced an expansion of its multimodal biological database, initiating a effort to sequence 100,000 whole genomes.
- The dataset aims to integrate deep genomic profiles with longitudinal clinical records to fuel algorithmic target discovery and predictive oncology modeling.

**[Biotech]** **[Allarity Therapeutics sponsors $100M SPAC vehicle](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2098382774730141885)** — *BioStocks / X*
- Allarity Therapeutics sponsored the initial public offering of Allarity Acquisition Corp., targeting a $100 million base offering size.
- Allarity's sponsor entity will retain approximately 25% ownership of the SPAC to acquire clinical-stage biopharma assets.

## Public Health & Policy

**[EU legal advisor recommends scrapping 80% pharma funding burden for wastewater](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/09/11/pharma-wins-cost-of-wastewater-treatment-fight-europe/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT+*
- An Advocate General for the European Court of Justice issued an opinion recommending the annulment of proposed EU directives mandating that pharmaceutical companies fund 80% of urban wastewater micro-pollutant removal costs.
- The opinion cites disproportionate financial allocation and arbitrary targeting of human healthcare products.

**[US CDC concludes largest recorded Cyclospora outbreak](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/11/cyclospora-outbreak-declared-over-origin-unknown/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT+*
- Public health agencies officially closed the investigation into the largest domestic outbreak of *Cyclospora cayetanensis* food poisoning in US history.
- The specific agricultural vector or supply chain point of origin remains unidentified despite extensive traceback analyses.

**[Hierarchical Bayesian analysis uncovers sub-national transmission dynamics in DRC Bundibugyo outbreak](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.19.26360792)** — *medRxiv*
- Spatial modeling of the 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease (BDBV) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo revealed marked divergent trajectories obscured by national reproduction number (Rt) averages.
- Epicenter regions (Ituri) showed sustained decline (median Rt < 1.0), whereas newly seeded provincial fronts maintained active expansion vectors, underscoring the necessity of spatially granular public health interventions.

***

**Worth watching:** Watch for potential fallout across the oral SERD therapeutic class following AstraZeneca's camizestrant SERENA-4 Phase 3 miss, particularly regarding patient selection criteria and combination backbones in early-stage HR+/HER2- breast cancer.
